title: Global well-posedness of cubic fractional Schrödinger equation with rough data
summary: In this paper, we apply the I-method to establish global well-posedness for the fractional nonlinear Schrödinger equation with initial data u_0 \in H^s(R^d) for s <α/2, i.e., below the energy threshold. Moreover, for radial initial data, we combine a modiffed Morawetz estimate-recovered via Balakrishnan's formula-with the I-method to obtain improved results. In the same spirit, we employ the "upside-down" I-method to derive polynomial-in-time growth bounds for the higher-order Sobolev norm.
